what: The paper debrief sheet read on Chrome's built-in model, measured on a local page with the command post's own code path (local page, same code path): the gate with the sheet's image options, debriefSheetGenerator (ONLY_ON_DEVICE, private request options), readDebriefSheetOnDevice and its checks
browser: Stephen's Google Chrome 157.0.8103.80 stable on this Mac (macOS, Apple M5 Pro); the built-in model reported available for image + text and for text only; its model version was not recorded
page: web/harness/sheet.html (dev server http://127.0.0.1:5176), bare Firebase app with no App Check and no sign-in, at the commit that adds the page
sheet: The SAMPLE debrief sheet as the app prints it (Print debrief sheets, Add a filled SAMPLE sheet): a screen capture of the rendered page, 720 x 952 pixels, with made-up values in a handwriting face and no person named. A rendered sheet, not a camera photo of a handwritten one.
context: Checked against a made-up search with segments AA and AB and teams Alfa and Team 2

runs.note: first read after the browser started the page
the same page, right after run 1
a freshly loaded page, opened as segment AB's debrief

problems.segment: This sheet is for segment AA, not AB.

reply.worked: LINE SEARCH 10 M APART ALONG THE CREEK
reply.didNotWork: THICK BRUSH ON THE NORTH SLOPE

findings: Every run read all eight boxes as printed, ran on this laptop as the SDK reported, and made no request to a Google or Firebase host.

The first read took 31,088 ms, longer than the 30,000 ms the command post then allowed a sheet read, so a first read in the command post would have been refused as too slow; later reads took 3,842 and 7,372 ms.
Opened as another segment's debrief, the read flagged the segment, as the code's check intends.

Not measured: a camera photo of a handwritten sheet, other laptops or browsers, and the click path inside the signed-in command post (the browser checks on the debrief harness cover that path with a canned reply).
n: 3 runs on 1 rendered sheet; timings are single observations, not distributions
